en.title: Casablanca Full-Day Trip from Marrakech
en.seo_description: Private full-day trip from Marrakech to Casablanca: the Hassan II Mosque, the Ain Diab Corniche, the Habous Quarter and Mohammed V Square, with hotel pick-up and a private driver.
en.summary:
Discover Casablanca, Morocco's largest city and economic capital, on a full-day excursion from Marrakech.

This journey takes you north across the Moroccan plains to explore a fascinating city where modern architecture, historic neighbourhoods and traditional Moroccan culture come together.

The highlight of the excursion is the spectacular Hassan II Mosque, one of the largest mosques in the world, beautifully situated overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.

Enjoy the city's impressive landmarks, explore its traditional quarters and discover the cosmopolitan atmosphere of Casablanca.

Good to know: visitors entering the Hassan II Mosque must follow the official dress code, covering shoulders, chest and knees. Interior visits are conducted at scheduled times with an official guide, and entrance fees are paid separately. The trip is available daily, subject to confirmation. The itinerary and timings may be adjusted depending on traffic, mosque visiting schedules and local conditions.
highlights: Visit the spectacular Hassan II Mosque.
Enjoy panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean.
Explore the famous Ain Diab Corniche.
Admire Mohammed V Square and Art Deco architecture.
Enjoy a full-day private excursion from Marrakech.

facts.departs_from: Your hotel or riad in Marrakech

itinerary.title: Marrakech – Casablanca – Marrakech
body: 07:00 | Departure from Marrakech: your driver will collect you from your hotel or riad in Marrakech. Travel in a comfortable, air-conditioned private vehicle towards Casablanca via the A7 motorway. The journey takes approximately 2.5–3 hours, covering around 240 km.

10:00 | Arrival in Casablanca, Hassan II Mosque: begin your visit with the magnificent Hassan II Mosque, one of Morocco's most impressive architectural landmarks. Built partly over the Atlantic Ocean, this extraordinary monument is famous for its impressive minaret, intricate Moroccan craftsmanship and spectacular oceanfront location. You will have time to admire the exterior and explore the impressive esplanade. You can also join an official guided tour of the mosque's interior, subject to visiting hours and availability.

11:30 | The Corniche of Ain Diab: continue towards the Ain Diab Corniche, Casablanca's famous Atlantic coastline. Enjoy beautiful ocean views, discover the seaside atmosphere and stop for photographs along the waterfront.

12:30 | Lunch break: enjoy free time for lunch at one of Casablanca's local restaurants or seaside cafés. You can discover traditional Moroccan cuisine or choose from the city's international dining options.

14:00 | Habous Quarter, the New Medina: explore the charming Habous Quarter, also known as the New Medina. Discover its traditional architecture, narrow streets, artisan shops, local bakeries and colourful markets. This neighbourhood offers a wonderful opportunity to experience Moroccan culture and shop for traditional handicrafts.

15:00 | Mohammed V Square and the Art Deco city centre: continue to Mohammed V Square, one of Casablanca's most famous public spaces. Admire the surrounding French-colonial and Art Deco architecture, beautiful fountains and impressive administrative buildings.
16:00 | Departure for Marrakech: after discovering Casablanca, begin your return journey towards Marrakech, with a short comfort stop along the motorway if needed.
19:00 | Arrival in Marrakech: arrive back at your hotel or riad, bringing your Casablanca adventure to a memorable end.

included: Hotel or riad pick-up and drop-off in Marrakech
Free time at the main attractions
Flexible stops for photographs and refreshments
excluded: Hassan II Mosque entrance ticket and official guided tour
